license_required.quote: A person may not engage in or work at the business or trade of or hold out to the public that the person is an electrician, electrical contractor, residential electrician, journeyman electrician, or master electrician in this state until the person has received from the department a license or permit to work as an electrical contractor, residential electrician, journeyman electrician, or master electrician.

exams.name: Master Electrician Examination
exams.notes: At least 80 questions covering national electric code and board rules/applicable laws under Title 37.
exams.quote: An applicant for a license as a master electrician shall file an application on a form furnished by the department, submit appropriate fees, and satisfactorily pass an examination prescribed by the board.

exams.name: Journeyman Electrician Examination
exams.notes: At least 60 questions covering national electric code and board rules/applicable laws under Title 37.
exams.quote: The examination for a journeyman's license must consist of at least 60 questions designed to fairly test the applicant's knowledge and the applicant's technical application skills

exams.name: Residential Electrician Examination
exams.notes: At least 50 questions covering national electric code and board rules/applicable laws under Title 37.
exams.quote: The examination for a residential electrician's license must consist of at least 50 questions designed to fairly test the applicant's knowledge and the applicant's technical application skills

available.quote: The board may authorize the department to issue a license as a master electrician, journeyman electrician, or residential electrician to an applicant without written examination on satisfactory proof that the applicant has the qualifications to apply for a license under this chapter and is the holder of a valid license issued by a city or other political subdivision of this state which provides for the examination and licensing of electricians.
